1.8 Resume and protect a comparison

The Python checkpoint key binds cache version and both absolute paths. Reuse requires matching device, inode, size, nanosecond mtime and ctime on both sources. Successful metadata/image results can be cached; errors and unverified raw or auxiliary groups are retried. Rerunning rebuilds the JSON reports from the current inventory and reusable checkpoint.

A filesystem identity check avoids rereading unchanged files, but it is not a cryptographic freshness guarantee against a privileged actor who can replace bytes while preserving all recorded facts. If the audit requires fresh payload reads, use --fresh or a new report directory. A remount can invalidate the Python device stamp and cause a reread.

The Python comparator holds a nonblocking Unix lock for its output directory. Do not edit source metadata, replace images, alter the report database or start a second owner while it runs. Read-only access can still update filesystem access times; that is excluded from verdicts. Keep output directories outside the photo roots to avoid accidentally treating reports as source material in later archive commands.
